cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I'll look after your dog while the kitchen is repaired. Bring his usual food; sudden diet changes are poor practice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He needs to stay overnight. You'd have to give him breakfast.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. Stay in my guest room and I'll show you the correct portion before bed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stay, but you're doing the six o'clock walk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed, I'll organise that. Walk before breakfast, please. Set your alarm for five thirty; I won't have him rushed because the handler overslept.

reason: A agrees throughout but professional feeding and timing corrections repeatedly return work to B, culminating in the explicitly reassigned alarm.
